Summary / CRM notes:
- Company: Linchpin Agents — mid-market SaaS vendor building multi-tenant conversational agents for vertical B2B apps.
- Primary contact: CTO (Maya Lin), Head of Platform (Evan Torres). Buying committee includes infra lead + security.
- Workload: multi-tenant chat agents that call external tools (search, order-system APIs). Need stable streaming so UX doesn't drop.
- Latency targets: p50 token latency target ~100-150ms; p95 tail under 350ms for US customers. Currently using cloud-hosted small GPU fleet, costs rising as tenant volume grows.
- Proof requirements: 2-week hosted POC that reproduces tenant spike scenarios (200 tenants), measure: latency SLO, stream interruption rate, function-calling latency, and accuracy/regression on model outputs. Also need demonstration of per-tenant rate-limiting/quotas and ability to set per-route limits.
- Security: must pass SOC2 questionnaire, require SSO (SAML), audit logs, and KMS for encryption. EU customers require data residency (may want Dedicated in EU).
- Pricing convo: prefers a predictable Dedicated baseline for core tenants + hosted for low-volume customers. Looking for blended pricing / burst credits.
- Quote from CTO: "We can't have tenant interruptions during stream handoffs — if the model stalls 1s on a token, adoption drops."
- Technical asks for POC: trace-level latency breakdown, kernel/quantization profile, suggestions on batching vs per-tenant isolation, sample config for per-tenant quotas. SE follow-ups: upload sample tenant load script, provide Dedicated sizing worksheet, share draft SLA language.
- Current blockers: exec sign-off on budget (Feb-March), security review completion, and a clear cost comparison for Dedicated vs current infra.
- Next actions: send POC runbook + Dedicated pricing tiers by 2026-03-10; schedule kickoff 2026-03-15 (tentative).
